```python
import sys
import argparse
import traceback

try:
    import sirf.STIR as pet
    import sirf.Utilities as ut
    import numpy as np
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
except ImportError as e:
    print("Error importing SIRF or dependencies:", e)
    sys.exit(1)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="PET scatter estimation using SIRF.")
    parser.add_argument('--raw', required=True, help='Raw PET data file (sinogram)')
    parser.add_argument('--randoms', required=True, help='Randoms data file')
    parser.add_argument('--acf', required=True, help='Attenuation correction factors file')
    parser.add_argument('--norm_path', required=True, help='Path to normalization and attenuation files')
    parser.add_argument('--norm', required=True, help='Normalization file')
    parser.add_argument('--attn_image', required=True, help='Attenuation image file')
    parser.add_argument('--output_prefix', required=True, help='Output prefix for scatter estimates')
    parser.add_argument('--non_interactive', action='store_true', help='Non-interactive mode (no plots)')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        # Redirect SIRF output to avoid clutter
        msg_redir = ut.MessageRedirector('info')

        # Load acquisition data
        print("Reading raw data...")
        acq_data = pet.AcquisitionData(args.raw)
        print("Reading randoms data...")
        randoms_data = pet.AcquisitionData(args.randoms)
        print("Reading attenuation correction factors...")
        acf_data = pet.AcquisitionData(args.acf)

        # Set up scatter estimator
        print("Setting up scatter estimator...")
        scatter_est = pet.ScatterEstimator()
        scatter_est.set_input(acq_data)
        scatter_est.set_randoms(randoms_data)
        scatter_est.set_attenuation_correction_factors(acf_data)
        scatter_est.set_path_to_normalisation_files(args.norm_path)
        scatter_est.set_normalisation_filename(args.norm)
        scatter_est.set_attenuation_image_filename(args.attn_image)
        scatter_est.set_output_filename_prefix(args.output_prefix)

        print("Initialising scatter estimator...")
        scatter_est.initialise()

        print("Estimating scatter...")
        scatter_est.estimate_scatter()
        scatter_data = scatter_est.get_output()

        # Save scatter estimate
        scatter_filename = args.output_prefix + "_scatter.h5"
        print(f"Writing scatter estimate to {scatter_filename}...")
        scatter_data.write(scatter_filename)

        if not args.non_interactive:
            # Display scatter estimate
            print("Displaying scatter estimate...")
            scatter_array = scatter_data.as_array()
            mid_slice = scatter_array.shape[1] // 2
            plt.figure()
            plt.imshow(scatter_array[0, mid_slice, :, :], cmap='hot')
            plt.title('Scatter Estimate (central sinogram slice)')
            plt.colorbar()
            plt.show()

            # Plot sinogram profile
            print("Plotting sinogram profile...")
            profile = scatter_array[0, mid_slice, scatter_array.shape[2] // 2, :]
            plt.figure()
            plt.plot(profile)
            plt.title('Sinogram Profile (central view, tangential)')
            plt.xlabel('Bin')
            plt.ylabel('Counts')
            plt.show()

        print("Scatter estimation completed successfully.")

    except Exception as e:
        print("An error occurred during scatter estimation:")
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```
